meta.name: build
meta.description: Implement a scoped software change for a customer and verify its behavior. Use for delivery work with an understood outcome, not incident response.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按明确需求改好一段代码,并验证它真的按预期运行。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一个范围明确的改动,要做完并确认它没坏。
copy.tagline_en: Ship a scoped code change and confirm it runs as expected.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have one well-defined code change to build and verify.

howto.what: 它会为客户实现一个范围明确的软件改动,并验证改动后的行为。动手前先读任务上下文契约和方法文档,再按客户的仓库说明与可用工具执行;缺失能力或未跑的检查会如实报告。
howto.when: 适用于结果已明确的交付类工作,不用于事故响应。若由 @fde 调用,会复用其当前上下文包和范围,不重做已完成的设置与提问。

say.text: 按这个范围把改动实现出来,再验证它的行为
say.note: 先读上下文契约和方法,再实现并验证

say.text: 这是我给客户的改动清单,实现并检查是否符合预期
say.note: 会如实报告缺失能力或未跑的检查

say.text: 沿用 @fde 的上下文继续,不用重新问一遍
say.note: 复用已有上下文包和范围

howto.what_en: It implements a scoped software change for a customer and verifies its behavior. It first reads the task context contract and the method, then works from the customer's repo instructions and available tools; missing capabilities or unrun checks are reported honestly.
howto.when_en: Use for delivery work with an understood outcome, not incident response. When called by @fde, it reuses the current packet and scope instead of restarting setup or questions.

say_en.text: Implement the change within this scope and verify its behavior
say_en.note: Reads the context contract and method first

say_en.text: Here's the customer's change list — implement it and check the behavior
say_en.note: Reports missing capabilities or unrun checks honestly

say_en.text: Continue from @fde's context; don't re-ask discovery questions
say_en.note: Reuses the existing packet and scope
